summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input remains historical and cannot auto-promote to v2 authority; v2 assigns explicit candidate roles, with only normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input authorized; separate sourceSelectionHash and sourceContentHash; selection binds roles, repo-relative paths, modules, scope, resource sets; content binds selected bytes; adapter owns transport, ranges, continuation, coverage, truncation; ready receipts are immutable generations under skill-input-generations/<binding-hash>/; validated non-authorizing current pointer is atomically advanced and sole consumer resolution mechanism; independent execution/publication/semantic-review gates; Knowledge self-change derived from changed-set and canonical path policy; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal references, active attempts; committed evidence deletion requires maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; consumers must migrate to v2 before 8-18 creates a current receipt; historical current directories remain immutable pending approved retention; no lifecycle authority, Knowledge publication, or Bootstrap initiation; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices
